# Forlì FC 26-27 Home Kit Released

OFFICIAL

Aug 9, 2026, by Phan Tich Giay

  * Serie C
  * Forlì FC
  * Ready
  * Kits

12 3

Italian club Forlì FC and technical kit supplier Ready have officially unveiled the team's new home jersey for the 26-27 season. The design stays true to the club's traditional identity while introducing neat subtle detailing across the torso.

The Forlì FC 26-27 home shirt features a classic half-and-half look split vertically down the center in red and white. The sleeves invert the primary colors of each side, featuring a white sleeve attached to the red half and a red sleeve on the white half. A trim V-neck collar, white Ready branding, and an all-over tonal pattern of the club's signature rooster motif complete the design.
